verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents its own data-access paths for this story: 'custom views and exports' in the product, and API operations (companyCaptable, companyTransactions) that return a company's full cap table and transaction rows in pages. This shows the data can be taken out, but no Excel/CSV or other open file format is documented, and the export mention is tied to compliance reports, not the whole cap table and history. Missing for 10: explicit Excel/CSV export of the complete cap table, a documented full transaction-history file export, a statement of on-demand export at any time with no lock-in, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage

citations.quote: One-click equity compliance reports, custom views and exports, make meeting compliance deadlines a breeze.
companyTransactions and companyCaptable can return a company's rows in pages, and only the rows that changed since an earlier request.
The operation user can retrieve cap table data about the queried company.
